verdict.rationale: FreshBooks' accounting page says founders can "grant your accountant access to real-time data" and that the accountant can "update your journal entries and chart of accounts" and run reports. That covers inviting an external accountant to review and adjust the books, and it is positioned as a dedicated accountant access path. missing for 10: explicit documentation of role or permission granularity (what the accountant role can and cannot see or edit), the invite workflow and how many accountant seats are allowed, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
